statement: For a continuous noncuspidal section of the rational tripod, every pulled-back Legendre rational Tate representation is absolutely irreducible. Finite ramification for one coefficient prime at least five is equivalent to cofinite ordinary integrality of the associated local sections and to one common finite ramification set for the full system. Under these equivalent hypotheses the rational system is realized by an elliptic curve over Q. No finite-ramification assertion for an arbitrary section and no point-section classification are claimed.

notes: Root read the full candidate and opened Pan, Serre, Berger, Stix, Milne, Stein, Khare-Rajan and the full KLR author-preprint statements. Degeneration independently approved the complete proof and cuspidal warning; its review excludes the separate KLR version audit. Arbitrary cuspidal splittings are included locally, with the possibly ramified infinity twist retained. Cofinite integrality permits finitely many cuspidal local sections, so D.5/StixCor6 cannot be applied without an additional argument. The matching elliptic system does not reconstruct the full nonabelian section or identify its local parameters. The separate genuine cuspidal e5*Kummer(13) example has monodromy ranks1 and0 at coefficient primes5 and7 despite matching semisimple Frobenius polynomials; code/D_legendre_modularity_checks.py and .json give exact finite checks. KLR numbering and weight1 are explicitly attributed to opened arXiv:math/0309283v1, not its unopened final journal text. D1-D4 remain unresolved.
